scope: Non-video release hardening and local handoff validation.

runtime.caveat: Local Node.js/npm are below the declared and pinned versions; no registry-backed dependency install or official React build was run.

offlineStructuralTypecheck.detail: Not the official TypeScript 7 project build.

canonicalContentValidation.detail: 45 core questions (15 each at Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced), 6 Expert Challenge scenarios, 51 explanations, 204 answer-option rationales, and 38 sequential IEEE references/BibTeX mappings.

highConfidenceSecretPatternScan.detail: High-confidence pattern guardrail only; not comprehensive SAST or external secret scanning.

legacyStaticBuild.detail: Copy-based distribution, not bundled/minified Vite production build.

packagedDistributionSmoke.detail: Health, root, canonical content, GET/HEAD, 404, method guard, security headers and graceful shutdown.

backupSmoke.detail: Checksum, exclusions, permissions and inside-tree refusal.

systemdUnitSyntax.detail: Syntax verification only; not installed on a production host.

javascriptSyntaxChecks.detail: Legacy app modules, server and packaging script.

sourceManifest.detail: SHA-256 and byte-size inventory verified against the extracted final full-source ZIP.

fullSourceArchive.detail: Exact archive file-set comparison, excluded-path/path-traversal checks, ZIP integrity, extracted SHA-256/size re-verification and final checksum verification.

applicationDemoArchive.detail: Every extracted demo file matches the corresponding source file; packaged-server smoke passed; extracted static Nginx config passed 10/10 live checks.

browserPlaywrightAndAxe.detail: Local Chromium loopback navigation was blocked by the runtime (ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ADMINISTRATOR); browser/axe CI remains a release gate.

npmCiAndAudit.detail: Cannot establish a lockfile-backed install/audit in this runtime.

officialReactTypeScriptViteBuild.detail: Requires committed reviewed lockfile and declared CI runtime.

reactArchive.detail: React migration remains source-only until official production build succeeds.

productionHostValidation.detail: TLS/HSTS, host allow-list, monitoring, off-host backup, restore and rollback require target-host access.

independentExpertAndLearnerReview.detail: No independent SME/instructional-design or learner-evaluation evidence supplied.

releaseChecksums.detail: Final source and application-demo ZIPs verified with sha256sum -c.
